The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• Burying bones or scattering demonic ashes.
• Offering bones or ashes on a gilded altar and the chaos altar, or to the Ectofuntus.
• Converting bones with the bonecrusher or ashes with the ectoplasmator.
• Cremating vyre corpses in the Columbarium or with a Sunspear.
• Cleansing the Corrupted Seren Stone with cleansing crystals.
• Running laps around the Hefin Agility Course while the Voice of Seren is active in the Hefin district.
• Using the attuned ectoplasmator.
• Completing Eep's Bounty of Bones collection.
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• Playing a minigame that rewards experience in this skill.

Gaining this item is based on the amount of experience awarded at once; the more experience granted per action, the greater the chance of obtaining this item. 
The chance P of receiving the pet on any particular action is
P = \frac{(B / 40) \times S}{50,000,000},
where:
• B is the base experience per action.
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 200 is applied to this value.
